value.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: Admission credited a lane-requested hard obstruction template requiring fresh SAT solving at a canonical near-complete tier. The submitted proof exposes the opposite: non-completability is a trivial corollary of linear-maximality (any incomplete linear-maximal partial is automatically uncompletable), so no SAT certificate or Fano-residue obstruction is present; the leave-triangle census decides everything. The object is arbitrary (seeded greedy output seed 285, with DRAFT admitting seeds 11,94,285,298 of first 300 all give 48-block triangle-free-leave witnesses and greedy routinely reaches 43-51 blocks), and the number 48 is an unexplained slice within that routine band, not a proved cutoff, extremum, classification, or named structure. DRAFT disclaims any count or universality. Certification (VERIFY_OK) does not create value per STANDARD: certification alone does not rescue an arbitrary object or unexplained number. A future researcher has no reason to retrieve this specific random list versus millions of equivalent greedy outputs; it changes no stated boundary (no prior theorem asserted all such fragments complete) and supplies no reusable obstruction pattern beyond elementary pair counting. Hence independently not worth finding later: value FAILS.
